claim: Try a running four-player sample without changing real games.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the seeded running game and tableclock-demo database

claim: After the first visit, the demo works without a connection.
sandbox: fresh context at /demo; obtain service-worker control, set offline, reload, and end a turn

claim: The timer supports two to eight players.
sandbox: fresh setup; add through eight players and remove down to two, asserting the boundary controls

claim: Player names stay in this browser.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the demo IndexedDB record exists and every observed request is same-origin

claim: A setup link includes player names and clock rules without uploading them.
sandbox: fresh demo; create a link, open it in another fresh page, and assert names/rules with same-origin requests only

claim: Tableclock runs on one shared phone; cross-phone sync is not included.
where: landing facts, running clock, privacy/terms, README
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert the visible scope facts and absence of a sync action

claim: Tapping the active field starts the next player’s turn.
sandbox: fresh demo; tap the running active field and assert the next named player is active
